jeirecipetree.recipe_tree.help:
The recipe tree shows the process, total material cost, and leftovers; cost rows are centered under the final product.

Left-click a material node to pick its recipe: the JEI recipe list opens, and once you save a recipe it is bound to that node (other recipes for the same material no longer replace it). When a slot has several candidates and none is locked, the first left-click opens the picker so you choose which item it is; click once more for the recipe page. Left-click a category icon to open the current recipe's own page.

Shift-left-click resolves: it takes the first candidate recipe for that material (skipping recipes excluded from automatic selection) and expands it. Shift-right-click clears that resolution and turns the node back into a raw material, ignoring the library default.

Right-click folds a node, right-click again unfolds it; the folded state is kept. The + at the icon's top-right opens the in-tree ingredient picker (the same step as picking the material); the + at the node's top-left moves this level's direct inputs into the crafting grid; the + at the screen's top-left picks a library recipe as the new tree root. Repeated identical slots are merged; locking an alternative applies it to every merged slot. Without a lock, every alternative participates in inventory, highlighting, and transfer checks.

Recipes live in your player library: click Add to recipe tree in JEI to add one, and click a material node in the tree to add a recipe for it. Crafting mode highlights base materials. In bookmarks, missing base materials are red and missing intermediate products are orange; products and costs stay visible even when already obtained. Bookmark rows need a modifier: Shift-left-click transfers only its direct inputs, Ctrl-left-click recursively crafts only the currently missing steps, and a plain left-click goes back to JEI. Timed machines only receive materials.

Scroll to zoom and drag to move. Scroll the xN label to change batch size; click it for minimal leftovers. E, Escape, or the tree button returns. Right-click the tree button or press Ctrl+C to clear the tree; R recenters it.
